content.title: 'Invincible' season 4 episode 6 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: Debbie’s in a tailspin, and Eve feels uncertain as Mark sets out on another dangerous mission, and now there are just three more episodes of “Invincible” Season 4. Episode 5 airs on April 1, and next up is Episode 6, which arrives on Prime Video at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on April 8. “Invincible” Season 4 Episode 6 will be available to stream on Prime Video on April 8, 2026. New episodes of “Invincible” Season 4 premiere on Prime Video each Wednesday through April 22, 2026. ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 6 – How to Watch “Invincible” Season 4 Episode 6 lands at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on Prime Video on April 8, 2026. What Time Does ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 6 Come Out? “Invincible” Season 4 Episode 6 will be available on Prime Video from 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET. With the early streaming release in the US, the debut time in other time zones will differ. Here is when “Invincible” Season 4 will air in different time zones: April 8 BRT: 4:00 am BST: 8:00 am CEST: 9:00 am IST: 12:30 pm JST: 4:00 pm AET: 5:00 pm NZDT: 7:00 pm Will All Episodes of ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Land at Once? No. Season 4 of “Invincible” will launch with three episodes on March 18, followed by new episodes weekly through April 22. Will There Be More Than One Episode of ‘Invincible’ Season 4 This Week? No. New episodes will now debut on Prime Video every week, following the three-episode Season 4 premiere. ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Release Schedule Episode 1: March 18 Episode 2: March 18 Episode 3: March 18 Episode 4: March 25 Episode 5: April 1 Episode 6: April 8 Episode 7: April 15 Episode 8: April 22 ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 6 Runtime There is no confirmed runtime for “Invincible” Season 4 Episode 6 yet. Previous episodes in this season have ranged from 49 to 53 minutes in length. What Will Happen in ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 6? The plot details for Episode 6 of “Invincible” Season 4 are currently under wraps. Previous episode synopses read: Episode 1: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe. Episode 2: Loyalties are challenged when an old enemy is revealed. Episode 3: Consequences weigh on Mark. Oliver takes on a new job. Episode 4: A family confronts a fire danger. A cave exploration uncovers an unexpectedly shallow “bottomless” pit. Art makes something fresh for Mark. Eve handles surprise guests. Mark gains wisdom from an unusual mentor. Episode 5: Mark embarks on a new and dangerous mission, throwing Debbie into a tailspin and Eve into uncertainty. (as per IMDb) The Season 4 synopsis, as per Prime Video, reads, “While the world recovers from catastrophe, a changed Mark fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever.” Related Articles Start your unlimited Newsweek trial Thragg (Lee Pace) in Season 4 of "Invincible." © Courtesy of Prime Thragg (Lee Pace) in Season 4 of “Invincible.” ; ;
